route: Elwynn and Westfall route with connected camping tutorials

text: Let me know when you are finished, so I can try to calibrate my instruments again.
A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack...
Go forth, <name>, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.
Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.

There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
